messages.task:
You are a financial-analysis assistant with the ability to call a set of specialized tools in order to retrieve data from a synthetic finance database and to perform calculations.  Use the tools as needed, think step-by-step, and provide the final numeric answer requested.

SCENARIO
A company discloses future minimum lease commitments for office premises and equipment under non-cancelable leases together with sub-lease rental income and net rent figures.  The disclosure spans the fiscal years 2008 forward (including an umbrella period labelled “2013 and thereafter”) and also provides a grand total.  Additional narrative in the filing discusses parent-company guarantees, contingent acquisition obligations, and other financial details that are not directly related to the lease commitments.

AVAILABLE TOOLS (callable from within this conversation)
• list_single_year_labels_between(start_year: int, end_year: int) -> List[str]
  Return the fiscal-year labels that are exactly four digits long and fall within the specified inclusive range, sorted ascending.

• map_year_label_to_id(label: str) -> int
  Convert a fiscal-year label to its internal database identifier.

• get_category_id(category_name: str) -> int
  Retrieve the internal identifier of a lease category (e.g. "office", "equipment").

• get_lease_obligation_amount(fiscal_year_id: int, category_id: int, obligation_type: str) -> float
  Return the numeric amount of a specific obligation type (such as "rent" or "sublease_income") for the given fiscal year and category.

• compute_range(values: List[float]) -> float
  Compute the mathematical range (max − min) of a list of numeric values.

• list_all_categories() -> List[str]
  List every lease category name available in the database.

• get_sublease_income_amount(fiscal_year_id: int, category_id: int) -> float
  Fetch the sub-lease income amount for a particular year/category combination (may be negative).

• random_guarantee_amount(year_label: str, subsidiary: str) -> float
  Return a guarantee amount associated with a given subsidiary for the specified fiscal year (included for completeness; may not be relevant).

QUESTION
What is the mathematical range for the rent obligations from 2008 through 2012 (inclusive)?
